description: Native Claude and Codex paired memory opportunity measurements share a bounded Python runner. Capture requires explicit workspace configuration and native hook trust. Existing context-experiment selector/finalizer behavior and provider authorization remain unchanged.

hooks.command: if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/memory-opportunity.py" ]; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/memory-opportunity.py" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; else :; fi
if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/memory-opportunity-session.py" ]; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/memory-opportunity-session.py" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; else :; fi
if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/memory-opportunity-tool.py" ]; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/memory-opportunity-tool.py" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; else :; fi
if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/memory-opportunity-stop.py" ]; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/memory-opportunity-stop.py" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; else :; fi
